title: Where do I mail my LISTSERV requests commands
issue: Where do I mail my LISTSERV requests commands
resolution_html: When you send mail to LISTSERV, you are actually sending a LISTSERV command. To send a command to LISTSERV, address your mail tolistserv@node (where node can be any node, for example listserv@yorku.ca) and then type the appropriate LISTSERV command in the body of your mail message. You can issue more than one command provided each command appears on a separate line
